import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np
import json

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Colors - consistent across all panels
COLORS = {
    'Communicable': '#C44E52',
    'NCD': '#4C72B0',
    'Injury': '#DD8452',
}
BG = '#FAFAFA'
GRID_COLOR = '#E0E0E0'
TEXT_COLOR = '#2D2D2D'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.facecolor': BG,
    'figure.facecolor': '#FFFFFF',
    'axes.edgecolor': '#CCCCCC',
    'axes.labelcolor': TEXT_COLOR,
    'xtick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'ytick.color': TEXT_COLOR,
    'text.color': TEXT_COLOR,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 14))
fig.suptitle('The Global Epidemiological Transition: Disease Burden Shift, 1990 → 2024',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98, color=TEXT_COLOR)
fig.text(0.5, 0.955, 'Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALYs) by cause category — Communicable diseases, Non-communicable diseases, and Injuries',
         ha='center', fontsize=10, color='#666666')

# Layout: 2x2 grid + bottom legend
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.38, wspace=0.3, top=0.92, bottom=0.08, left=0.06, right=0.96)

# ── Panel A: Global category totals (structural transition) ──
ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_a.set_title('A. Global DALY Composition: 1990 vs 2024', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

cats = ['Communicable', 'NCD', 'Injury']
totals_1990 = {r['category']: r['dalys_millions'] for r in data['global_category_totals']['data'] if r['year'] == 1990}
totals_2024 = {r['category']: r['dalys_millions'] for r in data['global_category_totals']['data'] if r['year'] == 2024}
sum90 = sum(totals_1990.values())
sum24 = sum(totals_2024.values())

x = np.array([0, 1.2])
width = 0.45
bottom90 = 0
bottom24 = 0
for cat in cats:
    p90 = totals_1990[cat] / sum90 * 100
    p24 = totals_2024[cat] / sum24 * 100
    ax_a.bar(0, p90, width, bottom=bottom90, color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    ax_a.bar(1.2, p24, width, bottom=bottom24, color=COLORS[cat], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
    # labels inside bars
    if p90 > 8:
        ax_a.text(0, bottom90 + p90/2, f'{p90:.0f}%', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, color='white', fontweight='bold')
    if p24 > 8:
        ax_a.text(1.2, bottom24 + p24/2, f'{p24:.0f}%', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, color='white', fontweight='bold')
    bottom90 += p90
    bottom24 += p24

ax_a.set_xticks([0, 1.2])
ax_a.set_xticklabels([f'1990\n({sum90:.0f}M DALYs)', f'2024\n({sum24:.0f}M DALYs)'], fontsize=10)
ax_a.set_ylabel('Share of Total DALYs (%)')
ax_a.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax_a.set_xlim(-0.5, 1.7)
ax_a.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5)
ax_a.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_a.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_a.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Arrow annotation
ax_a.annotate('', xy=(0.85, 65), xytext=(0.35, 65),
              arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#888888', lw=1.5))
ax_a.text(0.6, 68, 'Transition', ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#888888', style='italic')

# ── Panel B: Income group stacked bars (1990 vs 2024 side by side) ──
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_b.set_title('B. DALY Composition by Income Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

income_order = ['Low income', 'Lower-middle income', 'Upper-middle income', 'High income']
income_short = ['Low', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High']
ig_data = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']

positions = np.arange(len(income_order))
bar_w = 0.35

for yi, (year, offset) in enumerate([(1990, -bar_w/2), (2024, bar_w/2)]):
    for i, ig in enumerate(income_order):
        row = [r for r in ig_data if r['year'] == year and r['income_group'] == ig][0]
        bot = 0
        for cat, key in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
            val = row[key]
            bar = ax_b.bar(i + offset, val, bar_w, bottom=bot, color=COLORS[cat],
                           edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.85 if year == 1990 else 1.0)
            bot += val
    # year labels
    ax_b.text(len(income_order)-1 + offset, 103, str(year), ha='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#666')

ax_b.set_xticks(positions)
ax_b.set_xticklabels(income_short, fontsize=9)
ax_b.set_ylabel('Share of Total DALYs (%)')
ax_b.set_ylim(0, 110)
ax_b.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5)
ax_b.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_b.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_b.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Add 1990/2024 labels at top of first group
ax_b.text(0 - bar_w/2, 103, '1990', ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#888')
ax_b.text(0 + bar_w/2, 103, '2024', ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#888')

# ── Panel C: Bump/slope chart for rank changes (top 10) ──
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
ax_c.set_title('C. Rank Change of Top DALY Causes: 1990 → 2024', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

top10 = data['top10_daly_causes']['data']
causes_1990 = {r['cause']: r for r in top10 if r['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {r['cause']: r for r in top10 if r['year'] == 2024}
all_causes = set(list(causes_1990.keys()) + list(causes_2024.keys()))

# Positions
left_x, right_x = 0.15, 0.85
ax_c.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax_c.set_ylim(0.5, 12.5)
ax_c.invert_yaxis()
ax_c.set_axis_off()

# Draw rank labels
for rank in range(1, 11):
    ax_c.text(left_x - 0.01, rank, str(rank), ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9, color='#999')
    ax_c.text(right_x + 0.01, rank, str(rank), ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, color='#999')

ax_c.text(left_x, 0.3, '1990', ha='center', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#666')
ax_c.text(right_x, 0.3, '2024', ha='center', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#666')
ax_c.text(left_x, 11.3, 'DALYs (M)', ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#999')
ax_c.text(right_x, 11.3, 'DALYs (M)', ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#999')

# Track used positions for causes only in one year
off_screen = 11.5

for cause in all_causes:
    r90 = causes_1990.get(cause)
    r24 = causes_2024.get(cause)
    rank_left = r90['rank'] if r90 else off_screen
    rank_right = r24['rank'] if r24 else off_screen
    cat = (r90 or r24)['category']
    color = COLORS[cat]

    lw = 2.5 if abs(rank_left - rank_right) >= 3 or rank_left == off_screen or rank_right == off_screen else 1.5
    alpha = 1.0 if abs(rank_left - rank_right) >= 3 or rank_left == off_screen or rank_right == off_screen else 0.6

    # Draw connecting line
    if rank_left <= 10 and rank_right <= 10:
        ax_c.plot([left_x + 0.12, right_x - 0.12], [rank_left, rank_right],
                  color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, solid_capstyle='round')
    elif rank_left <= 10:
        # exits top 10
        ax_c.plot([left_x + 0.12, (left_x + right_x)/2], [rank_left, 11.2],
                  color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', solid_capstyle='round')
    elif rank_right <= 10:
        # enters top 10
        ax_c.plot([(left_x + right_x)/2, right_x - 0.12], [11.2, rank_right],
                  color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', solid_capstyle='round')

    # Left labels
    if r90:
        label = f'{cause}  ({r90["dalys_millions"]:.0f})'
        ax_c.text(left_x + 0.005, rank_left, label, ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                  color=color, fontweight='bold' if lw > 2 else 'normal')
    # Right labels
    if r24:
        label = f'{cause}  ({r24["dalys_millions"]:.0f})'
        ax_c.text(right_x - 0.005, rank_right, label, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                  color=color, fontweight='bold' if lw > 2 else 'normal')

# Annotations for dropped causes
dropped = [c for c in causes_1990 if c not in causes_2024]
new = [c for c in causes_2024 if c not in causes_1990]
if dropped:
    ax_c.text(0.02, 12.0, 'Exited top 10: ' + ', '.join(dropped), fontsize=7.5, color='#999', style='italic')
if new:
    ax_c.text(0.98, 12.0, 'Entered top 10: ' + ', '.join(new), fontsize=7.5, color='#999', style='italic', ha='right')

# ── Legend ──
legend_elements = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['Communicable'], label='Communicable (incl. maternal, neonatal, nutritional)'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['NCD'], label='Non-communicable diseases (NCDs)'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['Injury'], label='Injuries'),
]
fig.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower center', ncol=3, fontsize=10,
           frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fancybox=True, shadow=False,
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.01))

fig.text(0.98, 0.005, 'Data: GBD-style modeled estimates; 2024 figures are projections',
         ha='right', fontsize=7, color='#AAAAAA')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='#FFFFFF')
print('Done')

income_short = ['Low', 'Lower-\nmiddle', 'Upper-\nmiddle', 'High']
ig_data = data['daly_by_income_group']['data']

positions = np.arange(len(income_order))
bar_w = 0.35

for yi, (year, offset) in enumerate([(1990, -bar_w/2), (2024, bar_w/2)]):
    for i, ig in enumerate(income_order):
        row = [r for r in ig_data if r['year'] == year and r['income_group'] == ig][0]
        bot = 0
        for cat, key in [('Communicable', 'communicable_pct'), ('NCD', 'ncd_pct'), ('Injury', 'injury_pct')]:
            val = row[key]
            bar = ax_b.bar(i + offset, val, bar_w, bottom=bot, color=COLORS[cat],
                           edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.85 if year == 1990 else 1.0)
            bot += val
    # year labels
    ax_b.text(len(income_order)-1 + offset, 103, str(year), ha='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#666')

ax_b.set_xticks(positions)
ax_b.set_xticklabels(income_short, fontsize=9)
ax_b.set_ylabel('Share of Total DALYs (%)')
ax_b.set_ylim(0, 110)
ax_b.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.5)
ax_b.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_b.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax_b.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Add 1990/2024 labels at top of first group
ax_b.text(0 - bar_w/2, 103, '1990', ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#888')
ax_b.text(0 + bar_w/2, 103, '2024', ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#888')

# ── Panel C: Bump/slope chart for rank changes (top 10) ──
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
ax_c.set_title('C. Rank Change of Top DALY Causes: 1990 → 2024', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

top10 = data['top10_daly_causes']['data']
causes_1990 = {r['cause']: r for r in top10 if r['year'] == 1990}
causes_2024 = {r['cause']: r for r in top10 if r['year'] == 2024}
all_causes = set(list(causes_1990.keys()) + list(causes_2024.keys()))

# Positions
left_x, right_x = 0.15, 0.85
ax_c.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax_c.set_ylim(0.5, 12.5)
ax_c.invert_yaxis()
ax_c.set_axis_off()

# Draw rank labels
for rank in range(1, 11):
    ax_c.text(left_x - 0.01, rank, str(rank), ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9, color='#999')
    ax_c.text(right_x + 0.01, rank, str(rank), ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, color='#999')

ax_c.text(left_x, 0.3, '1990', ha='center', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#666')
ax_c.text(right_x, 0.3, '2024', ha='center', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#666')
ax_c.text(left_x, 11.3, 'DALYs (M)', ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#999')
ax_c.text(right_x, 11.3, 'DALYs (M)', ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#999')

# Track used positions for causes only in one year
off_screen = 11.5

for cause in all_causes:
    r90 = causes_1990.get(cause)
    r24 = causes_2024.get(cause)
    rank_left = r90['rank'] if r90 else off_screen
    rank_right = r24['rank'] if r24 else off_screen
    cat = (r90 or r24)['category']
    color = COLORS[cat]

    lw = 2.5 if abs(rank_left - rank_right) >= 3 or rank_left == off_screen or rank_right == off_screen else 1.5
    alpha = 1.0 if abs(rank_left - rank_right) >= 3 or rank_left == off_screen or rank_right == off_screen else 0.6

    # Draw connecting line
    if rank_left <= 10 and rank_right <= 10:
        ax_c.plot([left_x + 0.12, right_x - 0.12], [rank_left, rank_right],
                  color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, solid_capstyle='round')
    elif rank_left <= 10:
        # exits top 10
        ax_c.plot([left_x + 0.12, (left_x + right_x)/2], [rank_left, 11.2],
                  color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', solid_capstyle='round')
    elif rank_right <= 10:
        # enters top 10
        ax_c.plot([(left_x + right_x)/2, right_x - 0.12], [11.2, rank_right],
                  color=color, linewidth=lw, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', solid_capstyle='round')

    # Left labels
    if r90:
        label = f'{cause}  ({r90["dalys_millions"]:.0f})'
        ax_c.text(left_x + 0.005, rank_left, label, ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                  color=color, fontweight='bold' if lw > 2 else 'normal')
    # Right labels
    if r24:
        label = f'{cause}  ({r24["dalys_millions"]:.0f})'
        ax_c.text(right_x - 0.005, rank_right, label, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                  color=color, fontweight='bold' if lw > 2 else 'normal')

# Annotations for dropped causes
dropped = [c for c in causes_1990 if c not in causes_2024]
new = [c for c in causes_2024 if c not in causes_1990]
if dropped:
    ax_c.text(0.02, 12.0, 'Exited top 10: ' + ', '.join(dropped), fontsize=7.5, color='#999', style='italic')
if new:
    ax_c.text(0.98, 12.0, 'Entered top 10: ' + ', '.join(new), fontsize=7.5, color='#999', style='italic', ha='right')

# ── Legend ──
legend_elements = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['Communicable'], label='Communicable (incl. maternal, neonatal, nutritional)'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['NCD'], label='Non-communicable diseases (NCDs)'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['Injury'], label='Injuries'),
]
fig.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower center', ncol=3, fontsize=10,
           frameon=True, edgecolor='#CCCCCC', fancybox=True, shadow=False,
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.01))

fig.text(0.98, 0.005, 'Data: GBD-style modeled estimates; 2024 figures are projections',
         ha='right', fontsize=7, color='#AAAAAA')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='#FFFFFF')
print('Done')

- **Panel A**: Stacked bars showing the global structural transition from communicable-dominated (52%) in 1990 to NCD-dominated (62%) in 2024

- **Panel C**: Slope chart showing rank changes of top 10 DALY causes, with bold lines highlighting large shifts (e.g., lower respiratory infections dropping from #1 to #6, ischemic heart disease rising to #1)
